calculators.name: Investment Casting - Tree
calculators.description: The wax tree (carousel): layers of patterns stacked on the down pole up to the tallest tree the plant builds and every step of the route can take, the patterns of a layer around it; never more patterns than the batch.

fields.name: Layers
fields.formula: max(1, floor(({Max Tree Height} - {Runner Length Allowance} + {Layer Spacing}) / {Layer Pitch}))

fields.name: Tree Width
fields.formula: max({Runner Width} + 2 * ({Gate Length} + {Pattern Radial Dimension}), {Pattern Length})

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Metal per casting
calculators.description: Metal poured for one casting: its own weight over the gating efficiency of its size class (the rest is the gates, runner and pour cup).

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Material cost
calculators.description: Metal bought per casting: the net weight, the furnace melt loss, and the gating not returned to the furnace (the remelt allowance, percent).

fields.name: Bought Weight
fields.formula: {Net Weight} + {Melt Loss} + ({Poured Weight} - {Net Weight}) * (1 - min(max({Remelt Allowance} / 100, 0), 1))

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Wax pattern molding
calculators.description: One shot of the wax press: fill at the press flow rate, cool the thickest wall to the eject temperature (plate cooling by conduction to the die), open and close over the pattern height, and unload each pattern.

fields.name: Cool Time
fields.formula: ({Cooling Wall} / 1000) ^ 2 / (pi ^ 2 * {Wax Diffusivity}) * LN(4 / pi * ({Wax Melting Temp} - {Die Temp}) / ({Wax Eject Temp} - {Die Temp}))

fields.name: Open Close Time
fields.formula: {Open Stroke} / {Clamp Opening Speed} + {Open Stroke} / {Clamp Closing Speed}

fields.name: Shot Time
fields.formula: {Fill Time} + {Cool Time} + {Open Close Time} + {Chill Load Time} + {Handling Time} * {Cavities}

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Bench: Pattern finishing
calculators.description: Hand finishing of the wax pattern: its surface at the finishing rate.

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Bench: Tree assembly
calculators.description: Each gate of the pattern attached to the tree, plus the pour cup and the wax vents shared by the patterns of the tree.

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: {Gates} * {Time per Gate} + ({Pour Cup Attach Time} + {Wax Vents} * {Vent Add Time}) / {Patterns per Tree}

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Slurry dipping
calculators.description: The dips of one coat group (primary face coats, or secondary backup coats), each a dip of the whole tree; shared by its patterns.

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Sand coating
calculators.description: One stucco coat of the tree after each dip of the coat group; shared by its patterns.

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Robotic assist
calculators.description: The robot holding the tree through every dip and stucco coat; shared by its patterns.

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: {Dip Cycles} * ({Dip Time per Tree} + {Coat Time per Tree}) / {Patterns per Tree}

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Drying
calculators.description: The shell drying after every dip cycle and the final drying, for the tree; shared by its patterns.

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Dip Cycles} * {Drying per Dip Cycle} + {Final Drying}) / {Patterns per Tree}

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Flash fire de-waxing
calculators.description: One furnace load of trees: the soak time for the shell (by its dip cycles) plus loading and unloading each tree; shared by the trees of the load and their patterns. The bed holds the trees that nest on it, up to its drainage posts.

fields.name: Bed Capacity
fields.formula: max(1, min(floor({Nesting Factor} * {Bed Length} * {Bed Width} / {Tree Width} ^ 2), {Drainage Posts}))

fields.name: Load Time
fields.formula: {Soak Time} * 3600 + {Trees per Load} * ({Load Time per Tree} + {Unload Time per Tree})

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Steam autoclave de-waxing
calculators.description: One autoclave load of trees: the soak time plus loading and unloading each tree; shared by the trees of the load and their patterns.

fields.name: Bed Capacity
fields.formula: max(1, floor({Nesting Factor} * {Bed Length} * {Bed Width} / {Tree Width} ^ 2))

fields.name: Load Time
fields.formula: {Soak Time} + {Trees per Load} * ({Load Time per Tree} + {Unload Time per Tree})

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Bench: Wax vent plugging
calculators.description: Plugging the wax vents of the tree after de-waxing; shared by its patterns.

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Bench: Mold cleaning
calculators.description: Cleaning the shell with water or compressed air after de-waxing; shared by the patterns of the tree.

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Bench: Shell inspection
calculators.description: Inspection of the shell after de-waxing: visual, and the surface (blue dye) and internal (borescope) inspections the plant has enabled; shared by the patterns of the tree.

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Visual Inspection Time} + {Blue Dye Inspection Time} + {Borescope Inspection Time}) / {Patterns per Tree}

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Mold burnout
calculators.description: One furnace load of shells: the burnout soak time for the shell (by its dip cycles) plus loading and unloading each tree; shared by the trees of the load and their patterns.

fields.name: Bed Capacity
fields.formula: max(1, floor({Nesting Factor} * {Bed Length} * {Bed Width} / {Tree Width} ^ 2))

fields.name: Load Time
fields.formula: {Soak Time} * 3600 + {Trees per Load} * ({Load Time per Tree} + {Unload Time per Tree})

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Mold preheating
calculators.description: One furnace load of shells soaked at the preheat temperature (the same time for a full load or one tree) plus loading and unloading each tree; shared by the trees of the load and their patterns.

fields.name: Bed Capacity
fields.formula: max(1, floor({Nesting Factor} * {Bed Length} * {Bed Width} / {Tree Width} ^ 2))

fields.name: Load Time
fields.formula: {Soak Time} + {Trees per Load} * ({Load Time per Tree} + {Unload Time per Tree})

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Metal pouring
calculators.description: Melting one crucible of ingot, shared by the trees it fills, then pouring each tree and moving it to cool; shared by the patterns of the tree. The melt energy is the heat to the pouring temperature and of fusion, times the furnace factor.

fields.name: Trees per Crucible
fields.formula: max(1, floor({Furnace Capacity} * {Density} * {Crucible Fill Factor} / {Poured per Tree}))

fields.name: Energy per Casting
fields.formula: {Metal Melted per Tree} * {Heat of the Melt} * {Furnace Factor} / {Patterns per Tree}

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Melt Time per Crucible} / {Trees per Crucible} + {Pour Time per Tree} + {Move Time per Tree}) / {Patterns per Tree}

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Cooling
calculators.description: Chvorinov's rule: time in the shell = B x (V/A)^n, with the mould constant B from the metal and the investment shell (preheated to a share of the liquidus), times the plant's calibration factor; the tree cools as one, shared by its patterns.

fields.name: Mould Constant
fields.formula: {Heat Term} ^ 2 * pi / (4 * {Shell Conductivity} * {Shell Density} * {Shell Specific Heat})

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Knockout
calculators.description: Breaking the shell off the tree: the knockout time for the shell (by its dip cycles); shared by the patterns of the tree.

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Band saw cut-off
calculators.description: Cutting the casting off the tree: each of its gates at the band saw time for its weight.

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Bench: Abrasive wheel cutting
calculators.description: Cutting a casting too heavy for the band saw off the tree: each of its gates at the abrasive wheel time for its weight.

source.lookup: partMassBasedData.Abrasive Wheel Cut Time Per Gate (s)

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Belt sanding
calculators.description: Grinding the gate stubs flush: each gate at the belt sand time for the casting weight.

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Bench: Abrasive disc grinding
calculators.description: Grinding the gate stubs of a casting too heavy for the belt sander: each gate at the disc grinding time for its weight.

source.lookup: partMassBasedData.Abrasive Disc Grinding Time Per Gate (s)

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Bench: Finishing
calculators.description: Hand blending of surface imperfections over the share of the surface the casting weight calls for (never under the minimum time), and the visual check.

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: max({Minimum Finishing Time}, {Surface} * {Finished Share} / 100 / {Finishing Rate}) + {Visual Check Time}

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Bench: Dimensional inspecting
calculators.description: Gauging the inspected features of the casting, each at the single-feature inspection time.

calculators.name: Investment Casting - Wax pattern tooling
calculators.description: The wax pattern die over the lifetime volume: the single cavity mold base cost from the plant's regression on the mold base area and the pattern height (read in square inches and inches), with the tolerance, construction, finishing, cooling line and action allowances; one die makes its shots per tool.

fields.name: Tool Length
fields.formula: max({Minimum Tool Length}, {Pattern Length} + 2 * {Forming Margin Length} + 2 * {Base Margin Length})

fields.name: Tool Width
fields.formula: max({Minimum Tool Width}, {Pattern Width} + 2 * {Forming Margin Width} + 2 * {Base Margin Width})

fields.name: Single Cavity Base Cost
fields.formula: {Coefficient A} * {Base Area} ^ 2 + {Coefficient B} * {Base Area} + {Coefficient C} + {Height Multiplier} * {Pattern Height} / 25.4

fields.name: Allowances
fields.formula: 1 + {Tolerance Factor} + {Cavity Material Multiplier} + {Construction Multiplier} + {Finishing Multiplier} + {Cooling Lines Allowance} / 100 + {Slides} * {Slide Multiplier}
